attributes.name: Nefti Unwesha
attributes.powers:
Before you act, choose a card from your hand and shuffle it into a random open location deck.

You may reveal any number of allies; for each ally revealed, add 1 to your check to defeat.

"Had some luck with beer, but wine never took. Not cider, not Irrisen vodka either. Never made much sense to me, but for most seafarin' sorts, it's rum, or it's spit."—Nefti Unwesha, proprietor of the Mermaid's Bucket
